mainline: JOINT_CE positive and explicit negative source support
control: SOURCE_ONLY repeats positive CE twice for matched backward count; no tuning
loss: Mean of two native CE losses, no hinge or score constraints
scope: One source-local development pack; clinical BaseC denominator1 organ recognition, structure abbreviations present. Not unannotated evaluation or independent patient confirmation.
gate: JOINT both source answers correct; all three heldout B/D/E correct and at least one improvement over SOURCE_ONLY; clinical BaseC retained; no retained CORRECT control lost. Report all failures, no checkpoint/seed selection.
checkpoint_last_consumer: All17 outputs plus save/load, scoring and declared successor decision; then explicit retirement
